description: Security rules for Go files — prevents SQL injection, unsafe package misuse, error suppression, and secrets

rules.description: No SQL built with fmt.Sprintf — SQL injection risk
rules.message: Building SQL with fmt.Sprintf is vulnerable to injection — use db.Query with ? placeholders

rules.description: No unsafe package — bypasses Go's memory safety
rules.message: The unsafe package bypasses Go's type safety — document the justification with a comment

rules.description: Errors must be checked — do not discard with _
rules.message: Check the error return — use 'if err != nil' immediately after the call

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in Go files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use os.Getenv or a secrets manager
